ſoſtom. Epiſt. ad Olympiam) as leaſt offenſiue to his bretheren. For a more
ſpecial cauſe was, for his mother Rachels ſake, but moſt principal cauſe of
al was, for his great vertues, and mature iudgement: for which God alſo pre-
